description: Capture a saved model animationView timeline or turntable as a downloadable MP4. Use file: "project:<slug>"; inline code, GIF and PNG-sequence output are not supported on this hosted server. Limits: 60 seconds, 60 fps, 1800 frames, 200 MiB. Turntable width/height are even and at most 2048; timeline frames are 1920×1080. Returns downloads[].url with a 24-hour expiry; local_only links can expire earlier on restart. A completed capture with collisions remains ok:true, verified:false. This is rendered CAD, without synchronized electronics playback, audio, or video editing.

background.description: Turntable + publish: 'white' (default), 'light', 'dark', 'black', '#rrggbb', or 'transparent' (frames_dir only — MP4/GIF have no usable alpha).

duration_ms.description: Turntable: one full revolution in ms (default 6000).

elevation_deg.description: Turntable: camera elevation above the horizon in degrees (default 22).

environment.description: Turntable: HDRI environment override ('studio', 'softbox', 'neutral', 'outdoor', 'warehouse', a URL, or 'none').

file.description: Saved project source: project:<slug> or a Studio /p/<slug> URL. The server materializes source and attached assets; inline code is not supported.

focus.description: Show only matching feature ids / assembly part names in the rendered frames. Mutually exclusive with hide. Render-only; does not affect pose verification.

height.description: Turntable frame height in px (default 1080; even for MP4).

hide.description: Hide matching feature ids / assembly part names in the rendered frames. Mutually exclusive with focus. Render-only; does not affect pose verification.

no_verify.description: Skip the animation-pose interference verification (default: verify on).

output_path.description: Download filename ending in .mp4. The server chooses the directory; the result returns downloads[].url.

preset.description: Turntable look: 'publish' (default; studio product shot) or 'default' (engineering look).

shadow.description: Turntable + publish: soft contact shadow under the model (default true).

turntable.description: Seamless 360° orbit of the model instead of the animationView timeline.

verify_every.description: Additionally verify at every n-th frame time of the fps schedule (unioned with the keyframe sample set).

width.description: Turntable frame width in px (default 1080; even for MP4).

name: capture_animation
title: Capture Animation
